test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.

options.text: Development of Fine Motor Skills in Children

solution:
The correct answer is '**Development of Fine Motor Skills in Children**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage extensively discusses the various stages and milestones of **fine motor skill development** **in children**.
 
• It details how children evolve in their capabilities, starting from a reflexive grip at birth to being able to handle crayons and cut with scissors as toddlers.
 
• The focus is specifically on the abilities that involve small muscles in the hands, fingers, and thumbs, demonstrating tasks like writing, feeding themselves, and dressing.
 
• Every developmental milestone mentioned relates directly to the improvement of fine motor skills over time, making this title the most encapsulating for the content provided.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Fine Motor Skills**: This option, while relevant, is too generic and does not capture the specific focus on the development and stages of these skills as outlined in the passage.
 
• **Systematic Development of Children**: This title might seem applicable, but it’s too broad. The passage does not discuss the overall systematic development of children but specifically focuses on the aspect of fine motor skills.
 
• **Development of New-borns**: This title is misleading as it suggests the passage deals only with the initial stages of life. In contrast, the passage covers fine motor skills development from birth up to the age of four, making this option too narrow.
